decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:Location Plan, Ref: 226-0900, dated 04.08.2026Existing Site Plan, Ref: 226-0950, dated 04.08.2026Proposed Site Plan, Ref: 226-0951, dated 04.08.2026Existing Ground and First Floor Plan, Ref: 226-1000, dated 04.08.2026Existing Loft and Roof Plan, Ref: 226-1001, dated 04.08.2026Existing Sections AA, BB, Ref: 226-1100, dated 04.08.2026Existing Front, Rear and Side Elevations, Ref: 226-1200, dated 04.08.2026Proposed Ground and First Floor Plan, Ref: 226-1300, dated 04.08.2026Proposed Loft and Roof Plan, Ref: 226-1301, Rev A, dated 21.10.2026Proposed Sections AA, BB, Ref: 226-1400, dated 04.08.2026Proposed Front, Rear and Side Elevations, Ref: 226-1500, Rev B, dated 21.10.2026Proposed SuDS Plan, Ref: 226-0952, dated 17.08.2026Completed SuDS ProformaDesign, Access and Heritage StatementReason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interests of proper planning.

Unless otherwise specified in the application the materials to be used for the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted along with work of making good shall be carried out in materials to match those of the existing building.Reason: To ensure that the appearance of the development respects the appearance, existing materials and built and natural features of the surrounding area.

Prior to the commencement of the development hereby approved (including demolition and all preparatory work), a tree survey and relevant plans shall be submitted. This shall be prepared and completed by a qualified arboriculturist. The survey shall also include all the trees within influencing distance (NHBC 4.2) of the development. The survey shall also have regard to the area TPO to the west. The survey shall follow the guidelines set out in BS5837:2012 and shall include assessment of the tree's RPAs and canopy spreads. Following assessment of the trees, all details of required tree protective measures and specific foundation requirements (NHBC 4.2) shall be provided.Reason: To safeguard the health, longevity and amenity value of trees protected by the Area Tree Preservation Order and other retained trees in the interests of visual amenity, biodiversity and local character, in accordance with the NPPF, London Plan Policy G7 and Enfield's adopted development plan policies.

Prior to the installation of any air source heat pump or associated condenser equipment, full details of the proposed units shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The submitted details shall include the manufacturer and model of each unit, dimensions, siting, external appearance and finish, sound power levels, operating characteristics, details of any acoustic screening and vibration isolation measures, and an assessment of the cumulative noise arising from the simultaneous operation of all proposed units at the nearest noise-sensitive premises. The equipment shall thereafter be installed, operated and maintained in accordance with the approved details.Reason: To safeguard the residential amenity of neighbouring occupiers from noise and disturbance and to preserve the character and appearance of the conservation area.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015, or any amending Order, no balustrades or other means of enclosure shall be erected on the roof of the extension(s). No roof of any part of the extension(s) shall be used for any recreational purpose and access shall only be for the purposes of the maintenance of the property or means of emergency escape.Reason: To safeguard the privacy of the occupiers of adjoining properties.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (as amended), no windows, doors, rooflights, dormer windows or other openings shall be inserted into the external elevations or roof slopes of the development hereby approved other than those expressly shown on the approved plans, unless otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.Reason: To safeguard the privacy, outlook and residential amenities of the occupiers of neighbouring properties, in accordance with Policy D3 of the London Plan (2021), Core Policy 30 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010), and Policy DMD 8 of the Enfield Development Management Document (2014).
description: Single storey rear extension, alterations to existing side extension, installation of air source heat pump and air conditioning units and rear dormer involving front and side rooflights.
